title: Flat terms of the explicit affine alternating Cech model
statement: For a separated f:X -> Spec A, a finite family U:Fin r -> X.Opens consisting of affine opens, and an O_X-module G flat over f [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], every integer-degree term of the explicit complex K [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model] is a flat O_Spec A-module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No cover, quasi-coherence, derived counit, or base-change conclusion is assumed.

proof.text: Separatedness over Spec A makes the increasing-tuple intersections affine. Evaluate relative flatness at each intersection and the top affine open of Spec A; transport along GammaSpecIso to get flat A-section modules. Finite products of flat modules are flat.

The stalks of the associated sheaf of each flat A-module are its localizations, flat over A at the corresponding prime. Tensor and exactness are detected stalkwise, so the sheaf is tensor-flat. Negative terms and empty increasing-tuple terms are zero and flat.
